label: Skills
title: Skills Settings
subtitle: Define reusable instruction sets that agents can apply to any task.
description: The Skills tab is the global library of skills. Each skill is a named instruction template or code block that changes how an agent approaches a task when it is active.

settings.name: Skill Name
settings.description: Shown in the UI and used to identify the skill when assigning it to an agent.

settings.name: Trigger Description
settings.description: A short phrase used by auto-discovery to match this skill to relevant incoming messages.

settings.name: Prompt / Code
settings.description: The instruction template or code the agent receives when the skill is active.

settings.name: Enable / Disable
settings.description: Toggle a skill globally without deleting it.

mediaCaption: The Skills tab showing the skill list and the skill editor with a prompt template and enable toggle
tips: Write trigger descriptions as if you were describing the type of question that should activate the skill — auto-discovery compares this against the user's message.
Skills apply on top of the agent's system prompt, so you do not need to repeat instructions that are already in the prompt.
